summary: Iteration 14: validated the KırCan expert knowledge injection + narrative_drafts + consistency_warnings contract. Added /app/backend/tests/test_p14_narrative_consistency.py (4 tests, all passing serially): (1) expert_block() import/content invariants (6598 chars, 3 required sections), (2) real Claude Vision autofill on a Turkish legal narrative PNG — response contract complete with all 12 required keys; narrative_drafts contained 3 substantive paragraphs (7-12 sentences, 867-1283 chars each) merged into `fields`; consistency_warnings correctly flagged the deliberately injected 'Davacı adı yazımı' + 'cephe 25,30 vs 26,00 m' conflicts; missing_critical returned 6 expert-level follow-up questions; cost_try ≈ 4 TL, (3) insufficient balance → HTTP 402 with nominal hold refunded (wallet stayed ~0.01 TL), (4) SSE on mixed narrative + short-field user_template chat emitted delta + done events, ~380-970 chars of expert Turkish text, zero errors. Frontend: FAQ greeting's **KırCan Danışmanlık** renders as <strong> with data-testid='assistant-markdown' (no regression from P13). Static audit confirms data-testid='narrative-drafts-section', 'consistency-section', per-draft 'narrative-{field}', and 'Onayla ve Doldur' enable-logic (fields OR duplicates OR image_assignments non-empty) are correctly wired in ChatPanel.jsx.

minor.issue: Preview-env ingress (Cloudflare) returns 502 at ~75-80s while Claude Vision is still generating. On a single page PNG with 3 narrative fields the real end-to-end latency is 60-120s; isolated runs succeed, back-to-back runs sometimes 502 at the ingress edge even though backend eventually completes. Mitigated in the test with a 2-retry loop; product-side consider streaming the autofill output or lifting the ingress timeout.

The 6.6 KB kircan_knowledge.expert_block() is prepended as a plain string in the system prompt, not as a cache_control-tagged block. Claude SDK/LiteLLM supports marking the long static part as cached — would cut ~5-6s off every autofill. Nice-to-have.

action_items: Consider adding 'prompt caching' / anthropic-beta cache_control to the expert_block section of the autofill + user_template SSE system prompts — would reduce latency ~5-10% on every call and dodge the 75s ingress edge.
Optional: switch autofill response to a chunked/streaming endpoint so partial narrative_drafts are deliverable before the ingress ~75s cutoff.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2745 lines (grew ~100 lines for narrative_drafts + consistency_warnings merge + image_map). The autofill_chat_from_attachments handler alone owns ~380 lines (prompts + parsing + wallet reconcile + image_map + merge). Extract helpers: `_build_autofill_system(template, narrative_keys, image_slots, files)`, `_parse_autofill_json(text)`, `_merge_drafts_into_fields(parsed)`, `_reconcile_autofill_wallet(user, charged, hold)` — this would also make the retry/caching work in the action items trivial.

kircan_knowledge.expert_block() concatenates fresh strings on every call (NARRATIVE_EXEMPLARS join + f-string headers). For a function that's called on every autofill + every SSE message, this is wasted work — memoize with functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1) or compute at module import.
Autofill response includes `success: true` as a boolean but the frontend never checks it; either remove it or make the frontend respect it (e.g. show a toast if success=false).

The merge of narrative_drafts into `fields` (server.py:1452-1459) silently overwrites a short-field value if Claude puts the same key in both `fields` and `narrative_drafts`. Comment acknowledges this (`prefer the narrative draft`) — fine, but add a soft warning in `notes` when a collision happens so the UI can indicate 'we replaced your short value with the paragraph draft'.

Frontend ChatPanel.jsx uses `nd.field` as React key AND as part of a data-testid (`narrative-${nd.field}`). If Claude returns duplicate narrative_drafts entries for the same field (edge case), React will throw a key collision — defensively use `${i}-${nd.field}`.

success_rate.frontend: FAQ markdown rendering verified live (<strong> present, no literal ** in rendered text); narrative/consistency UI verified by static code audit (testids wired, enable-logic correct)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_p14_narrative_consistency.py. MUST be run with `-n 0` (serial) via `pytest -n 0 tests/test_p14_narrative_consistency.py` because the Claude Vision autofill call takes 60-120s and the preview ingress has a ~75s edge timeout — concurrent xdist workers trigger reproducible 502s. rca_of_the_issue: No product bug surfaced this iteration. (1) expert_block injection validated end-to-end: on a Turkish legal PNG, Claude produced 3 paragraph drafts (7-12 sentences each in bilirkişi diction), 2 real consistency warnings matching the planted inconsistencies, and 6 missing_critical follow-up questions — this proves _build_system_prompt (user_tpl branch) + autofill system prompt + response-merge logic all work. (2) Autofill 402 refund still correct: wallet drained to 0.01 TL → 402 Payment Required → wallet remained 0.01 (hold refunded). (3) SSE unchanged: data: {"type":"delta",...}\n\n frames interleaved with final data: {"type":"done","assistant_message":...} frame, non-empty assistant content, no error events, expert tone + follow-up questions as spec'd. (4) Observed 75s 502s are preview-env Cloudflare ingress timeouts, not application bugs — the backend LLM call eventually completes (verified in isolated 60s run). Testing agent added retry loop + action-item to add prompt-caching to shrink that latency.
